tutorial.title: Checking API Responses
tutorial.descriptionContent: Transfer response checks to harder situations and independent API-handling tasks.
tutorial.shortDescriptionContent: Python learners who want harder API response practice

lessons.title: Diagnose Error Codes

executableContent.instructions: Complete `script.py` so it calls `response.raise_for_status()` before `response.json()`. Print the response's `"name"` value when the request succeeds. Catch `requests.exceptions.HTTPError` and print `"Request failed"` when it doesn't.

files.name: script.py
files.content:
import requests

url = "https://things.mimo.dev/api/things/1"

try:
  response = requests.get(url)

  data = response.json()
  print(data["name"])
except requests.exceptions.HTTPError:
  print("Request failed")
files.solvedContent:
import requests

url = "https://things.mimo.dev/api/things/1"

try:
  response = requests.get(url)
  response.raise_for_status()
  data = response.json()
  print(data["name"])
except requests.exceptions.HTTPError:
  print("Request failed")
